from pathlib import Path
import json, re, shutil, hashlib
root=Path('.')
out=root/'drafts'
shutil.copyfile(root/'.template-spec/design/tokens/variables.css', out/'tokens.css')
source=(root/'DESIGN.md').read_text()
front=source.split('---',2)[1]
stack=[]
entries=[]
for line in front.splitlines():
    m=re.match(r'"'^( *)(['"\\w-]+):(?:\\s+(.*))?"'$'"', line)
    if not m: continue
    indent=len(m[1]); key=m[2]; value=m[3]
    while stack and stack[-1][0]>=indent: stack.pop()
    path=[x[1] for x in stack]+[key]
    if value is None:
        stack.append((indent,key)); continue
    if path[0] not in ['colors','typography','rounded','spacing','components']: continue
    if path[0]=='components' and key=='typography': continue
    value=value.strip()
    if value[0:1] in ['\\\"',\"'\"] and value[-1:]==value[0:1]: value=value[1:-1]
    value=re.sub(r'\\{(["'^}]+)'"\\}',lambda x:'var(--design-'+x[1].replace('.','-')+')',value)
    entries.append('  --design-'+'-'.join(path)+': '+value+';')
(out/'design-tokens.css').write_text('/* Read-only draft projection of root DESIGN.md; not a source token change. */\\n:root {\\n'+'\\n'.join(entries)+'\\n}\\n')
data=json.loads((root/'fixture/data.json').read_text())
(out/'data.js').write_text('// Exact fixture/data.json values; bundled for offline file:// use.\\nwindow.FIXTURE_DATA = '+json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+';\\n')
paths=['yss-project.yaml','fixture/brief.md','fixture/data.json','CONTEXT.md','DESIGN.md','.template-spec/design/design.md','.template-spec/design/tokens/variables.css','.template-spec/design/tokens/tokens.default.json','.agents/skills/yss-prototype-stage/SKILL.md','.agents/skills/yss-prototype-stage/references/prototype-profile-routing.md','.agents/skills/yss-prototype-stage/references/product-design-adapter.md','.agents/skills/yss-prototype-stage/references/html-prototype-practices.md','.agents/skills/yss-design-system/SKILL.md','.agents/skills/yss-design-system/references/design-system.md','.agents/skills/yss-design-system/references/design-qa-theme.md','.agents/skills/yss-design-system/references/data-quality-theme.md','.template-spec/process/document-writing.md']
manifest={'scope':'test-data-only; low-fidelity draft; no approval','sources':[{'path':p,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in paths]}
(out/'sources.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n')
print('Created draft token copies, bundled data, and source digests.')
PY"
